strings.name: Jody Williams
strings.summary: Williams moved from teaching and Central American human-rights work into international disarmament. Coordinating the International Campaign to Ban Landmines, she worked with civil-society groups toward the 1997 treaty and shared the Nobel Peace Prize with the campaign. She later co-founded the Nobel Women’s Initiative, supporting women peace activists and opposing landmines and autonomous weapons because of their lasting civilian harm.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Landmine campaign
strings.highlights.h1.text: Coordinated international civil-society networks and helped achieve the 1997 antipersonnel-mine treaty.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Women’s peace cooperation
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-founded the Nobel Women’s Initiative to support women activists and human security.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Opposed mine-treaty withdrawals
strings.timeline.t1.text: Criticized planned withdrawals by European states, emphasizing civilian protection.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Published memoir
strings.timeline.t2.text: Published My Name Is Jody Williams about grassroots activism.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Co-founded women’s initiative
strings.timeline.t3.text: Established the Nobel Women’s Initiative with fellow women laureates.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Began teaching in Houston
strings.timeline.t4.text: Began teaching peace and social justice at the University of Houston.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Shared Nobel Peace Prize
strings.timeline.t5.text: Shared the prize with ICBL; the mine-ban treaty was concluded that year.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Coordinated ICBL
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became founding coordinator and expanded the international civil-society network.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completed international-relations degree
strings.timeline.t7.text: Earned a master’s in international relations at Johns Hopkins.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed undergraduate studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from the University of Vermont before teaching and human-rights work.
